title: Languages of bounded tree size
statement: Given a function $T:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$, the set of languages of Boolean words having tree size bounded by $T$ consists of exactly those languages recognized by a family of Boolean tree circuits whose size at each input length $n$ is at most $T(n)$.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a function from natural numbers to natural numbers
